notes: Sourced from Crestron's official spec sheet (ss_tsw-1060, Rev 06/05/20), which includes a full "Connectors" section confirming exactly two physical connectors: (1) 8-pin RJ45 LAN PoE and (1) USB Type-A host. The unit is powered entirely via PoE/PoE+ through the RJ45 jack -- there is no separate AC/DC power inlet, so no additional power connector entry was needed. Audio (microphone, speakers) and camera are fully built-in with no external analog audio or video jacks exposed. This spec covers the standard TSW-1060-B-S/W-S models; the TSW-1060-NC variant is identical in physical I/O but omits the physical camera/mic/Bluetooth radio (no connector differences). Desktop/wall-mount touch panel -- rackUnits omitted since rack mounting requires a separately sold TSW-1060-RMK-2 accessory kit (4 RU), not part of the base unit.

ports.name: LAN PoE
ports.note: 8-pin RJ45, female; 100Base-TX Ethernet; also serves as PoE+ (802.3at Type 2) powered-device input carrying data, control, video, intercom, and power over a single wire

ports.name: USB
ports.note: USB Type A, female, USB 2.0 host port; used only for optional TSW-1060-LB light bar or hallway sign accessory; requires 802.3at Type 2 PoE+ to enable
